## Before You Submit

**Please search [existing issues](https://github.com/rishiskhare/parrot/issues) (including closed ones)** to see if this has already been requested or declined.

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve?

## Proposed Solution

How should Parrot behave if this is built?

## Alternatives

Anything else you considered, and why it wasn't enough.

## Fit

How this fits Parrot's goals: local, private, offline text-to-speech, and a forkable codebase.
